  c."hex_id",
  c."County",
  c."State",

  h2."ve_ae_fraction",
  f."nri_coastal_flood",
  p."hifld_energy_plants_n",
  s."hifld_energy_substations_n",
  t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p",
  v."nri_eal_HWAV",
  v."nri_eal_CWAV",
  r."road_crit_index",
  ROUND(COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) * COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) * COALESCE(h2."ve_ae_fraction", 0), 4) AS "coastal_gen_loss",
  ROUND(COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) * COALESCE(s."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) * COALESCE(r."road_crit_index", 0), 4) AS "downstream_grid_impact",
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) * COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) * COALESCE(h2."ve_ae_fraction", 0) +
    COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) * COALESCE(s."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) * COALESCE(r."road_crit_index", 0)
  , 4) AS "total_risk_score"
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" h1 ON c."hex_id" = h1."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" h2 ON c."hex_id" = h2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p ON c."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON c."hex_id" = s."hex_id"

LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v ON c."hex_id" = v."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" r ON c."hex_id" = r."hex_id"
WHERE c."State" IN ('TX', 'Texas')
  AND (COALESCE(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y", 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) > 0)
ORDER BY "total_risk_score" DESC;
```

SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    h."County",
    h."State",
    h."Zipcode",
    COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_CFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_RFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_HWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_CWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_TRND", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_HAIL", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_LTNG", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_SWND", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_WNTW", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_VLCN", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_TSUN", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_ERQK", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_LNDS", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_ISTM", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_HRCN", 0) + COALESCE(v_risk."nri_eal_DRGT", 0) AS compound_risk_score,
    v_sovi."sovi",
    v_inc."inv_median_income",
    v_psvi."psvi_score",
    c."nri_cri_score",
    b."building_count",
    l4."hospital_per100k",
    l1."groc_per1k"
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v_risk ON h."hex_id" = v_risk."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v_sovi ON h."hex_id" = v_sovi."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_001" v_inc ON h."hex_id" = v_inc."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v_psvi ON h."hex_id" = v_psvi."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CR_001" c ON h."hex_id" = c."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON h."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_004" l4 ON h."hex_id" = l4."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_001" l1 ON h."hex_id" = l1."hex_id"
ORDER BY compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
